_README: Sections that are NOT written by the author whose directory they land in.
Keyed by EPUB file stem; each entry is matched against the spine file path
or the first 100 characters of the section's text.
These cannot be found heuristically: nothing in the markup distinguishes an
introduction written by Stephen Fry from one written by Douglas Adams. They
are listed because someone checked who wrote them. Anything left in here is
prose the reference will attribute to the wrong person, in exactly the
sections most likely to be stylistically distinctive.
Deliberately NOT excluded: Pratchett's footnotes, author's notes, Feegle
glossaries, prologues and epilogues, and Adams's 'A GUIDE TO THE GUIDE'.
Those are the author writing, and several of them are the most
epub2md.py reports any entry that matched nothing, so a stale line here is
visible rather than a silent no-op.
